target_customer: Small and mid sized medical practices, for example internal medicine and GI groups
problem: Patients drop off after visits, with the company claiming about 30 percent of return visits never happen, and practices lack staff to follow up on results, refills and scheduling.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for EHR integrated AI agents
product_category: Healthcare voice and text AI agents for patient follow up and front desk work

founders.name: Natalia Khosla
education: London School of Economics, master's as a Fulbright Scholar
previous_startups: DesiSpace (social network for South Asian immigrant mental health)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page; the master's subject is stated as health policy on the profile and health economics in the launch post.

founders.name: Rachel O'Driscoll
previous_startups: Cayaba Care (built a brick and mortar and digital practice)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: began in clinical research, then health tech.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and text agents that must integrate with EHRs such as Epic and eClinicalWorks and document in the chart, with healthcare privacy requirements; the language model layer was becoming available in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: EHR integrations and practice workflows create some lock in, but many AI receptionist vendors offer similar scheduling and reminder features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents buying or copying Simbie; many other voice AI vendors for healthcare appeared by 2025 (Assort Health, Vocca and others).

market_need_then: The company claims missed return visits cost practices about 10 percent of revenue; these are unverified company figures.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and benefit focused on the site, with warmer patient facing copy that stresses a personal touch

branding.community_and_virality: Cited in Becker's Hospital Review per the site; no community or merch evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly invented name with no brand coverage found; one blog uses Simbie Health, suggesting inconsistent naming.

pivots.from: AI voice staff that answers phones and calls patients for small medical practices (earlier YC launch)
pivots.to: EHR integrated agents for post visit follow up
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page says an earlier launch described phone answering agents and the current page describes follow up agents

outcome_analysis: Simbie AI is active with a five person team and clinician founders. It claims 400X growth since January 2025, zero churn and fully inbound customers, but those are company claims and no funding round is confirmed. The story so far is an early stage vertical AI company in a crowded healthcare voice market.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: a Persana blog says $500K pre-seed led by YC in October 2023, Caplight and Standout say $500K total, FundedIQ says $5.0M. Nothing from the company or a press outlet, so no round is recorded. The 400X growth, 0 percent churn and 30 percent no return figures come from the YC page and are company claims. No dated competitor sources found near the batch. Founder education comes from the YC page.
